description: National Medicines Regulatory Authority - National Medicines Regulation (Registration & Licensing)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing legal and regulatory frameworks for medicine registration, licensing, and quality control. It outlines compliance requirements, application procedures, and regulatory standards, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
